response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: The number of matched records is counted as joined advancedbehavior-transaction pairs (COUNT(*)). Since translink is a single FK and transreg is the primary key, each advanced behaviour record matches at most one transaction record, so this equals the count of advanced behaviour records per mix.
Records with NULL ordertypedist form their own group, which GROUP BY does by default (shown as NULL).
